statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Continuous cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is ordered
The monitoring is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic etiologies contributing to these symptoms
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
Less intensive monitoring options were attempted and deemed inadequate prior to initiating this level of diagnostic testing
